issues.desc: index.json priority=high was auto-elevated from medium because the word token appears in title/description (riskSignals: Security/Credentials category). The token occurrences refer to LLM token counts (EstimatorKind, count_tokens), not auth/bearer/session tokens. CLAUDE.md documents this as a known mention-vs-modify false positive; the main agent should dismiss this riskSignal via story_review_dismiss before INIT_CHECK so priority reverts to medium. No actual security credential handling is introduced by this story.

CHK-004 context says: If the B-253e validator currently rejects a prompt-size-estimate with null output, make the minimal record.ts adjustment. Reading record.ts lines 452-489 shows the validator already permits null outputTokens for prompt-size-estimate (the non-null outputTokens rule applies only to provider-reported records). The conditional framing is harmless but slightly misleading — the implementer may waste time looking for a validator gap that does not exist. Suggest clarifying: currently null output is already accepted for prompt-size-estimate; no record.ts change is required unless a different null-dimension rejection is found during implementation.
